name: Demo script generator
description: Turns a named Sero feature into a filmable 60-second demo shot list: a hook line, timed scenes grounded in the real UI, on-screen approval points, spoken/caption lines, and honest caveats — written into docs/marketing/demo-scripts/.
recommendedTrigger: manual — add the feature to docs/marketing/demo-scripts/inbox.md (or answer the loop's question), then run
limitations: Drafts only — the shot list file in the workspace is the only output; nothing is posted, published, or sent. Scenes are grounded in what the repo shows, but film and verify the flow yourself before publishing.
